notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-Champion PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller) Another void exotic special weapon to add to a towering pile, Slayer's Fang might well find a place in a loadout. It's a slug shotty that, after your first kill, grants Nightsworn Sight for 7s - further kills grant 3s of Truesight and create subminitions that weaken enemies on hit. It intrinisically disrupts Overload chmapions, so won't be affected by seasonal shotgun mods or subclass verb effects. Boost the handling by +10 with Arrowhead Brake as the barrel perk, and Assault Mag decreases time between shots by ×0.9 in the magazine perk slot. Short-Action Stock as the grip perk increases Handling by +15 and, of the catalyst options, Repulsor Brace Retrofit fits in with the playstyle best, as you'll be close into enemies and probably in need of the overshield from killing weakened enemies. Maybe a bit unusual to use a slug shoutgun for crowd controlling adds, but this should chew through even bulky crowds efficiently.
